text: This solution, EQC-led Enhancement of Volcanic Risk, Loss Modeling, and Policy (EQC Volcanic Risk & Policy) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake (EQC), GNS Science, NIWA, MetService, Private insurers in New Zealand, Massey University, and CSIRO Data61. The program was implemented in 2014 and focuses on collaboration, leveraging tech, and regulation.
